entries.summary: As an Engineer at Betway Africa, I design and develop responsive, user-friendly web applications, features and optimisations using modern JavaScript frameworks and best practices in UI/UX design. I collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with back-end services, optimise website performance and enhance cross-browser compatibility. My focus on mobile-first design, accessibility and performance leads to improved user engagement and site efficiency, while my expertise in version control and Agile workflows ensures timely, high-quality project delivery.

Founded and run EZdev Solutions alongside full-time roles. EZdev owns and operates Votera (community-scheme management SaaS) and Chilli Collective (e-commerce), and delivers a small number of client projects: product design, full-stack development, payments, hosting and ongoing support.

Led a web development team building dynamic websites and e-commerce stores for international clients. Migrated code and parameters to QA and production and administered Microsoft Azure cloud environments for web and back-office servers. This provided hands-on experience complementing my Bachelor's degree in Information Technology.
comments: Successful integration into corporate working environments
